Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with diarrhea and central abdominal pain for 3 days.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Central abdominal pain has been present since onset, with no radiation and described as mild-to-moderate tenderness and cramping.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Eating and drinking provoke nausea and a feeling of gas.
Patient has had episodes of vomiting and is now unable to tolerate fluids or solids.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: After eating this morning, the patient vomited immediately.

Advised to stay at home for the time being.
